svg.title: Households reporting a shared own site, CASEN 2024
svg.desc: Valid n: sampled households with valid v9; missing: households with absent or invalid v9. CI bounded to [0, 1]. Observed zero stays zero; unavailable intervals and missing samples are never converted to zero. Source: CASEN 2024, Ministry of Social Development and Family. Data and method in the accompanying table.
